steps.speaker: Female Voice
steps.content: Hmm? Roulecca, he's awake.

steps.speaker: Girl's Voice
steps.content: Really?

steps.speaker: Girl's Voice
steps.content: What a pity. I was hoping everyone would take turns doing CPR on him, like how a prince would wake up a sleeping princess.
steps.female_content: What a pity. I was hoping everyone would take turns doing CPR on her, like how a prince would wake up a sleeping princess.

steps.content: A huge four-leaf clover hovers over you... No, it's a woman whose head is a four-leaf clover. Terrified, you jolt wide awake.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hey, what kind of reaction is that? How rude! Lucy is really pretty, so many people line up to court her! It's your honor to get a kiss from her!
Roulecca pokes you with her cheeks puffed up, then breaks into a smile.
Contrary to the information given by Nightingale, she doesn't seem irritable or unstable. In fact, she seems like a happy, ordinary child.
People who use Ambrosia will enter and indulge in their own sweet dreams.
Since it's not your dream, it's hers...

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hehe, I know you! You're the new Chief of Minos!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: You've been running around chasing after Sinners for months now, but you still haven't caught everyone, have you? Hehe, you're really unlucky. Did you get lost? How did you end up here?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Since you're already here, then come and enjoy my family's summer party! Daddy bought me the most beautiful beach!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Daddy's a dummy. He's in his room because he got heatstroke. Roulecca'll have to play with the Chief instead!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Roulecca's family welcomes you too!
Family... Is she talking about the four-leaf clover heads?
The pink sky, the pink sea... Everything before your eyes reminds you that this is a dream. A young girl's dream. Yet the girl doesn't realize it at all.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Ahhh... it hurts! What are you doing?
She didn't wake up. Instead, she covers her cheek with a pout. You've confirmed that in this mirage, your shackles don't work.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This is a dream. Come back with me, Roulecca.

steps.content: She suddenly reaches out and pinches your cheeks in revenge, squeezing one side after another. The pain is quite real. This definitely doesn't feel like a dream.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: It hurts, doesn't it? Still think this is a dream? Hehe, the Chief is a dummy, too.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hey... Come play! Didn't you come here for Roulecca's summer party too? The garden party is really fun!
You want to say something, but the atmosphere around you suddenly becomes tense. You feel like you are surrounded by cold glares from many...
"Play with Roulecca. Make her happy..." Even though the four-leaf clover people don't have eyes, you know they're staring at you. You haven't forgotten how aggressive they are in reality.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hehe, since we're at a beach, of course we should play... <color=#fb9259>beach volleyball</color>!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: On one side is the Mister Chief of Minos... On the other are Roulecca and the four-leaf clover family!
steps.female_content: On one side is the Miss Chief of Minos... On the other are Roulecca and the four-leaf clover family!

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: ...Roulecca is just a kid. Surely our big strong Chief can handle things solo?
You think about it. This little girl can barely touch the edge of the net even when she jumps. As for the four-leaf clovers...

The incoming sea breeze spins the four-leaf clovers' heads like windmills. It doesn't take long before all the clovers are dizzy and spinning on the spot. You suddenly feel confident, and think of a new idea.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: No problem. Let's start the game.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I win, what will you give me as a reward, Roulecca?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Hmph! Chief, how arrogant you are! No one has ever beaten Roulecca before, not even Daddy. What makes you so confident?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: All right, then. Since you're so courageous, I hereby announce that the player who collects three Roulecca medals will receive the highest honor of the four-leaf clover family—<size=40>the Diamond Roulecca Medal</size>!

steps.speaker: Four-leaf Clovers
steps.content: <size=40>The Diamond Roulecca Medal</size>!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Forget about the diamond. I want something else from Roulecca.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If I win, can you help me realize a wish?

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: How sly, hehe... Chief, you're as cunning as Daddy.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Sure. If you win the Diamond Roulecca Medal, Roulecca will grant you one wish, but only one.

steps.speaker: Roulecca
steps.content: Woosh! Let the game begin!
